svg.text: Bench rig — trigger + LED strip + motor
Breadboard upright, row 1 at the top. Each numbered wire or part is one step in README.md — do them in number order.
Match the rails by COLOUR on your own board, not by position. Use rows 1–30 only (long boards often split their rails further down).
Q1 RFP30N06LE in d20 / d21 / d22
printed face → LEFT edge, tab → gap
pin-5 pulldown into the pin-7 (GND) row
XIAO (U3). USB-C off the top. Use free holes outside it.
74AHCT125 (U2) in e / f. Notch toward row 10.
Strip data: R3 end + jumper 19 (left) → strip DIN (right).
Q1 gate / drain / source, all in column d.
MOTOR GROUND — Q1 S, R5, cell −, jumper 25. Nothing else.
BATTERY + after fuse — F1, CR1 band, motor +.
• Left red rail: nothing at all.
• Cell + never touches a rail — rows 27 and 25 only.
• Chip pins 8 and 11 stay empty. Pin 6 → R4 only.
• On: USB first, cell last. Off: cell first, then USB.
